name: Bing Wallpaper Folder
description:
Browse and apply wallpapers from the folder that Bing daily images are downloaded to. Automatically fetches the daily Bing image, lists every image in your wallpaper folder with on-demand thumbnails, search and copyright info, and stores metadata in a portable sidecar JSON file that travels with the folder.

以壁纸文件夹为事实来源的 Bing 每日壁纸扩展：自动拉取每日 Bing 图片，在面板菜单中浏览文件夹内全部图片（按需缩略图、搜索、版权信息），元数据存为可随文件夹迁移的 sidecar JSON。
